calibration_notice: Frozen threshold inherited from 100 separate COCO calibration originals in main; no comparison test score fits a threshold
metric_cohort_notice: Both implementations use exactly the same completed original-condition cases; main 300-test-original headline metrics are not compared to this 25-original cohort

timer_notes.per_method: Synchronized FSD extraction + original detection/attribution components + additional14-source raw-likelihood diagnostic pass; CPU output copies included; image processing, feature disk writes, differences and public API checks excluded.
timer_notes.an_extra: AN extraction includes its production residual/numerical diagnostics; upstream compute_fsd does not.
timer_notes.allocator: Timed method order alternates by fixed planned case index: even upstream then AN; odd AN then upstream. The schedule is unchanged by resume. CUDA cache is retained normally, and reserved memory can include preceding method allocations. Allocated/reserved are logical PyTorch memory, not resident physical VRAM; WDDM/system-memory fallback can permit values above6GiB.
timer_notes.reference: Saved main seconds used a different timer and are not the paired method timing.
timer_notes.processed_pixels: Literal upstream and fresh AN receive the exact same RGB PIL pixels and share the recorded pixel hash. Saved main has no stored processed pixel hash; reconstruction is linked through unchanged original-byte and transformation-code hashes.

runtime_power_stratification.case_interval_policy: Inclusive overlap of the entire case started_utc/finished_utc interval with the conservative incident window; equality at either boundary is flagged
runtime_power_stratification.limitation: Case-level overlap cannot identify which method's timed section was power-limited. Nonoverlap means outside the recorded window, not continuous proof of AC power. Strata are descriptive and not a randomized estimate of battery-power effects.

incident.description: The laptop switched to battery during the direct comparison; the GPU reported P8, 300MHz SM, 405MHz memory and a10W current power limit despite80W requested/default.
incident.timing_policy: Retain all cases for numerical/task comparisons and report all-case timings. Supplementary timing should flag any case overlapping the conservative interruption window, from the last preceding normal telemetry sample until confirmed AC restoration plus60seconds. Do not silently exclude these cases.
incident.source: Local nvidia-smi, GPU telemetry CSV, and Windows GetSystemPowerStatus observations
